def.name: Pine Hollow
def.blurb: Nine holes cut through pines and oaks. Guardian trees, two doglegs, water on 3, 6 and 9.

def.name: Cedar Meadows
def.blurb: Big rolling meadow holes at golden hour. Few trees, a lot of wind, drivers all day.

def.name: Lakeshore Links
def.blurb: Morning light off the lake. Carries, wraps and island greens; every pond is out of bounds.
